question: What is the Crude Death Rate of India as per Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.1%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Crude Death Rate:-**

 
 
• **The Crude Death Rate of India as per Census 2011 is 7.1%.**
 
• Crude Death Rate (CDR) is the number of deaths per 1,000 population in a given year. It is a measure of mortality in a population.
